title: 6. Into HAX
content:
You can now do what new HAX contributors do in their first weeks: read code, build an element, ship it, and change data with confidence. This chapter shows you how HAX fits together, where the work is, and has you publish a HAX site of your own.

Sites as folders of files, elements as blocks, and why that matters.

Fork this site, add HAX blocks, publish your copy and send a fix back.

How the issue queue works and how to pick something you can finish.

Make it in the browser, edit it on your computer, publish it from GitHub.

Where contributors go from here.
